title: Model Compatibility Matrix
summary: Run-of-record of live model-gateway measurements taken against a commercial-partition Bedrock deployment via a shared LiteLLM proxy, plus an explicit list of what remains unverified.
scope: Anthropic request surface (output_config.effort, thinking, output_config.format, temperature, budget_tokens)
structured output via single tool call
notes: Manifest declared DOC; heuristic and content analysis agree. Evidence/measurement record, not a decision record: it reports observations and defers every decision to the ADRs it cites (ADR-015, ADR-017, ADR-018, ADR-019), so it must not be treated as a source of locked decisions. SCOPE LIMIT, load-bearing for downstream synthesis: every measurement is COMMERCIAL-PARTITION only, reached through an organisation-shared LiteLLM proxy, and the document says nothing about AWS GovCloud. Q-01 remains OPEN and is not narrowed by this file; it is closed only by re-running the live smoke check in the target GovCloud account and appending that result as a SECOND run-of-record alongside the commercial one (per section 8, which forbids overwriting sections 1-6). Do not let any extraction present this document as evidence about GovCloud availability, model or inference-profile IDs, cross-region inference, or data routing. Section 5 also contains a self-correction: an earlier revision's claim that structured-output enforcement was a per-model-group property is explicitly retracted as a sample-size-1 artifact; the corrected finding is that output_config.format is unreliable on every group and a single unforced tool call works everywhere.
